purpose: Add a knowledge entry (org-scoped, optionally enterprise-scoped) used by Devin across sessions in the matching repo.

examples.invocation: Settings > Devin's Settings > Knowledge > Add > 'Coding standards' / 'When writing code in any repo' / 'Use TypeScript strict mode'

purpose: Programmatic equivalent of the UI 'Add knowledge' action. See devin/api leaf for full endpoint coverage.
Create a reusable instruction set, optionally with a `!`-prefixed macro for label-based triggering.

examples.invocation: Settings > Playbooks > Create > name='PR Review', macro='!review', instructions='Review the PR for bugs, security, style'
examples.expected_output: Playbook saved + macro `!review` available as label/keyword

command: [Jira/Linear] Add label `!plan` (or other macro) to a ticket
purpose: Trigger Devin with a specific playbook by adding a macro-named label to a ticket.

examples.expected_output: Devin starts a session using the !plan playbook
examples.scenario: Plan-only run on a feature ticket

purpose: Add a secret. Referenced as $NAME in blueprints/sessions/playbooks. Org-scoped; enterprise tier also available via Settings > Devin's base environment > Secrets.
Rotate a secret in place. New value takes effect on next build for blueprint-referenced secrets.

examples.invocation: Edit INTERNAL_NPM_TOKEN > paste new value > save
examples.expected_output: Next build picks up new value

purpose: Programmatic full CRUD on playbooks via the Devin MCP server. Supports macros.
Programmatic full CRUD on knowledge notes + suggestions via the Devin MCP server. Filterable by repo/folder/search.
